captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a firefighter's door wedge. It has a triangular wedge profile that tapers to a thin edge at one end, while the thicker end features chamfered corners and a small vertical hole for a lanyard. Along one of the long tapered sides, there is a series of ten vertical serrations or teeth designed to provide grip when wedged under a door.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric firefighter's door wedge with customizable length, width, and thickness. The wedge should feature a tapered profile, chamfered rear corners, a lanyard hole at the thick end, grip teeth along one side, and customizable engraved text on both the top and bottom faces.
captions.factory: The design starts with a main difference block that subtracts engraved text (using the write library) and a set of gripping teeth from a custom wedge module. The wedge module is built from a base cube, which is then trimmed along its diagonal using a rotated cube to create the wedge angle. Additional rotated cubes are subtracted at the thick end to create chamfered corners, and a cylinder is subtracted to form the lanyard hole. The teeth module uses a for-loop to translate and rotate ten small cubes at a 45-degree angle along the side of the wedge to subtract serrated notches.
